name: opencv_facedetect_demo
description: Migrate OpenCV face detection to Node.js based (https://docs.opencv.org/5.0/examples/opencv_contrib_modules_xobjdetect_samples_facedetect_cpp.html)

scripts.check-node: node -e "const v=process.versions.node.split('.')[0]; if (v !== '22') { throw new Error('Node 22 is required, current: ' + process.version); }"
